evidence.note: The upstream float instance uses CUDA_KERNEL_LOOP ownership, indexes labels and squared distances by batch row, and retains distinct similar, legacy, positive-margin, and zero-output branches.

The fixed-SHA adapter preserves CLLBackward<float> arithmetic and grid-stride ownership, derives count from batch*channels, rejects shapes outside the reviewed domain before payload access, and replaces only Caffe Blob/launch dependencies plus bool with an int32_t ABI flag.
The extraction is tied to Caffe commit 9b891540183ddc834a02b2bd81b31afae71b2153 with source, adapter, patch, license, and probe hashes.
